properties.title: NRC Report: Ferrous Chloride near Cedarville, MI
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 871130 - Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE - Suspected Responsible Party: CLARK TOWNSHIP WWTP
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 871130
Incident Time: 2008-04-07 13:00:00
Nearest City: Cedarville, MI
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: FERROUS CHLORIDE
Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE
Suspected Responsible Party: CLARK TOWNSHIP WWTP
Skytruth Analysis
THE CLARK TOWNSHIP WWTP OPERATES A FORCE SANITARY SEWER MAIN. A 24% SOLUTION OF FERROUS CHLORIDE IS FED INTO THE UNDERGROUND MAIN AT A RATE OF SEVEN GALLONS PER DAY THROUGH A 1/2" LINE LOCATED INSIDE A 1 1/4" DIAMETER LINE. ON APRIL 7, 2008 A "SEEP" (BUBBLES AND DISCOLORED WATER) WAS OBSERVED AT SURFACE IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY OF THE TIE-IN. THE "BUBBLING STOPPED WHEN THE FERROUS CHLORIDE PUMP WAS TURNED OFF. THE RELEASE "QUANTITY" IS ESTIMATED AT APPROXIMATELY 90 POUNDS OF FERROUS CHLORIDE TO THE SUBSURFACE. HOWEVER, GIVEN THE UNDERGROUND SITUATION, THE WORST CASE "QUANTITY" MAY BE AS HIGH AS 544 POUNDS. CLARK TOWNSHIP IMMEDIATELY (APRIL 7, 2008) CONTACTED THE MICHIGAN DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY (MDEQ) TO NOTIFY OF THE INCIDENT. MR. RANDY CONROY OF THE MDEQ VISITED THE AREA ON APRIL 9, 2008 AND PRESENTED HIS COMMENTS TO THE CLARK TOWNSHIP WWTP IN AN APRIL 30, 2008 LETTER. INITIAL ABATEMENT MEASURES WERE CONDUCTED BY MACKINAC ENVIRONMENTAL TECHNOLOGY, INC, (MET) AND INCLUDED MEASURING PH IN THE SOIL AND DITCH WATER, AND LINING THE DITCH WITH VISQUEEN TO MINIMIZE STORM WATER LEACHING OF IMPACTED SOILS. A STATUS REPORT WAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO MR. CONROY - MDEQ ON APRIL 30, 2008.
